title: Deliver keyword matches through shared scheduler and independent history

gates.name: Focused Docker package tests
gates.command: docker run --rm --network none -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src somon-price-hotfix-builder:latest sh -c 'CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -count=1 ./internal/app ./internal/store ./internal/telegram'

purpose: Deliver first/current matches once per search without weakening shared polling limits and retry.
success_outcome: Enabled searches deliver existing then new primary matches with named notifications and independent durable delivered/rejected history; errors/cap preserve retry and shared sequential backoff/single-flight.
anti_goals: Do not implement delete routes or adopt TASK-010 stale-delete proof.
Do not alter search management authorization, rental first-seen/fallback policy, source matching/catalog or pure price predicate.

forbidden_scope: commit, push, deployment, production runtime and production DB
real Telegram messages, secrets or allowlist/target-chat policy changes
FT-001..004 outcomes/task records/statuses/approvals; unrelated rental UI or fallback changes
direct SQLite writes outside Persistence Adapter; business orchestration in transport/composition
stop_conditions: An unresolved material product/contract/state/ownership branch is discovered.
Required scope changes task identity/tier/dependency/owned claims or affects production.
Honest compiling behavioral RED or preserved initial GREEN cannot be obtained for an owned claim; syntax/setup failure is not RED.

constraints: Primary owner: Polling Application (internal/app); uses Somon/Filtering/Telegram/Persistence via accepted boundaries. Store only records app decisions; Telegram only renders/delivers; no auth decisions change.
Reuse existing Go/CGO clients, scheduler, SQLite and test harness; expected paths are advisory.
Dependencies own their proof; current regression checks do not adopt their claims.
Use only local httptest endpoints and t.TempDir DB; network-disabled Docker gate uses existing builder image.
invariants: Rental data/behavior retain their existing owners; independent search IDs/history never use rental seen_ads as exclusion.
Admin allowlist, target-chat policy, callback acknowledgement and append-only output are preserved in new routes.
verification_targets: FT-005-AC-005 (REQ-012): temp-SQLite App+httptest source/Telegram: seed rental-seen same ad, enable two saved searches, poll first/next, reopen/restart, drop price, edit budget and reevaluate prior reject. Capture search phrase/title/price/city/photo/link and delivered IDs per search. First delivery must occur despite rental baseline/seen; delivered remains skipped across edits, each search receives same ID independently.

FT-005-AC-006 (REQ-013): controlled source parse/error and Telegram failure/ambiguity, cap=1 across rental+two searches, typed 403/429, repeated manual trigger. Observe request order/in-flight maximum=1, total details<=cap, shared HTTP delay/backoff and round-robin starting search; only successful delivery records delivered. Deferred/failed IDs retry after next allowed poll; source failure leaves search history unchanged. Send-success/store-write failure retains accepted possible-repeat ambiguity, no exactly-once claim.

Owned preimplementation RED: after creation dependencies are done, create/enable searches through real app operations and run existing scheduler, capturing no keyword delivery/history; same scenario after change proves GREEN. For failure/cap subcases trigger their real source/Telegram failures in the same harness, not artificial compilation failure; preserve baseline already-correct shared limits. Concurrent budget edit must make stale rejection conditional on revision; deletion/race proof remains TASK-010.

Use t.TempDir()/search.db via cfg.DBPath; seed records, close/reopen for restart, use httptest barriers and short controlled intervals rather than production. Rerun recreates DB/server; cancel scheduler context, close server/DB and remove temporary directory on cleanup.
evidence_required: FT-005-AC-005 — RED: enabled persisted searches produce no keyword notification/history through current polling. GREEN: per-search first/new ID trace and correct payload, one delivery across restart/edit/price drop, independent second-search delivery and re-evaluation of rejected IDs. Decisive comparison: captured per-search ad IDs plus durable delivered/evaluated-revision rows before/after reopen. Artifact: .tasks/TASK-009-T2-FT-005-W3/TASK-009-T2-FT-005-W3-acceptance-evidence.md.

FT-005-AC-006 — RED: enabled search failure/cap fixtures have no keyword retry lifecycle because searches are absent from polling. GREEN: failed/deferred IDs retry, success alone records delivered, source errors preserve rows and shared sequential delay/cap/backoff/single-flight hold; ambiguity-after-send remains allowed. Decisive comparison: failure→next-poll request trace, exact row deltas, observed total detail/in-flight counts and backoff state, with each subcase distinguished. Preserve initial-GREEN shared transport/scheduler constraints. Artifact: .tasks/TASK-009-T2-FT-005-W3/TASK-009-T2-FT-005-W3-acceptance-evidence.md.
